visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman is in a bedroom at night, holding a baby and smiling at the camera. The lighting is dim. (2) Close-up shot of a baby sleeping soundly with a blue pacifier. (3) The woman is in a brightly lit room, appearing to talk directly to the camera, touching her chin thoughtfully. (4) Montage of her setting up decorations: taping gold foil curtains to a shelf, writing a menu on a card, and unboxing a disco ball lamp. (5) She holds the disco ball as it projects rotating colorful light patterns onto her face and the room. (6) Wide shots of the room transformed with colorful lights and gold streamers; a cat sits on the floor. (7) A quick transition shows her in a new outfit (black turtleneck and plaid skirt) dancing energetically in front of the gold backdrop. (8) She makes an exaggerated angry face at the camera. (9) Shot of a man sleeping in bed in a dark room. (10) The man wakes up, looks disoriented, and enters the decorated living area. (11) He approaches the woman who acts as a bartender, handing him the handwritten card. (12) They interact playfully; he looks at the menu. (13) She presents a red box of Uni-President (麥香) Black Tea. (14) She uses a knife to cut the box open, revealing a large solid block of frozen tea. (15) She places the tea brick in a glass and pours a bottle of beer over it. (16) They cheer and drink together under the disco lights. (17) She shows a yellow box of Uni-President (麥香) Milk Tea. (18) She repeats the process: cutting the box, putting the frozen milk tea brick in a glass, and pouring coffee over it. (19) She tops the drink with a large amount of whipped cream from a canister. (20) They share the drink and pose romantically, making a heart shape with their hands. (21) She holds up three different boxes of tea (Milk Tea, Black Tea, Green Tea) and points towards the camera.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with long brown hair, wearing a black top and plaid skirt; a young Asian man with short black hair and glasses wearing a grey t-shirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video moves from a dimly lit bedroom to a living room decorated with gold tinsel curtains and colorful disco lights, then to a kitchen area where drinks are prepared.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic pop music starts. Female voice speaks quickly and excitedly. (2) Sound of soft, even breathing followed by a gentle 'shh' sound. (3) Sharp whoosh sound transition. (4) Rhythmic sounds of tape being pulled and paper rustling. (5) Bright 'sparkle' sound effect coinciding with disco lights turning on. (6) Music shifts to a steady dance beat with heavy percussion. (7) Deep snoring sound effect occurs over a visual of a sleeping man. (8) Sudden loud 'pop' or cartoon hit effect as the man wakes up. (9) Sound of a knife cutting through heavy cardboard with multiple strokes, followed by a metallic clink of a glass. (10) Crisp sound of liquid being poured into a glass, accompanied by the fizzing of carbonation. (11) Can opening tab click sound. (12) Steady hissing sound of pressurized whipped cream being dispensed. (13) Multiple layers of talking and laughing as the two main voices interact, ending with a cheerful final sign-off over continuing music.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Narrative Conflict (sleeping partner) -> Resolution through DIY Creativity -> Step-by-Step Tutorial -> Product Display -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote Uni-President (麥香) tea products by demonstrating how to create 'home bar' mixed drinks using frozen tea bricks, framing it as a fun and budget-friendly romantic activity for couples.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Prominent display of '麥香' brand logo, demonstration of product usage in recipes, and concluding with a product line showcase and call to try the recipes.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a very popular social media format: taking a common convenience store product and showing 'hacks' or 'secret recipes' to elevate it. The fast pacing and high text density are characteristic of high-engagement short-form video content.
